name: send-it
label: SendIt
description: Multi-platform social media publishing. Schedule and publish content to LinkedIn, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, X, and 30+ more platforms.

token.label: API Key
token.description:
To get your SendIt API key:
1. Log in to your [SendIt dashboard](https://sendit.infiniteappsai.com/dashboard)
2. Go to **Settings > API Keys**
3. Click **Create API Key** — the key is only shown once, so copy it immediately
4. Paste the key below (it starts with `sk_live_`)

get_scheduled_post.label: Get Scheduled Post
get_scheduled_post.description: Gets one pending scheduled post by schedule ID.

scheduleId.label: Schedule ID
scheduleId.description: The schedule ID returned by Schedule Post or listed by List Scheduled Posts (field id).

get_platform_requirements.label: Get Platform Requirements
get_platform_requirements.description: Gets the text limit and media rules for one platform.

platform.label: Platform
platform.description: Lowercase SendIt platform value, e.g. x, linkedin, instagram, threads, bluesky, tiktok, youtube, telegram, discord.
